title: Crystal headlights and interior crystal controls
summary: Feedback centers on crystal-themed headlights, controls, and dashboard trim, with praise for their appearance and some complaints about heat or condensation while many mentions are descriptive or preference-based without clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the look of the crystal headlights, controls, and dashboard trim, especially their sparkle and upscale interior styling.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on crystal headlights developing condensation and crystal controls becoming hot in the sun.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mention interest in crystal headlights, option removal, and subjective comments about crystal interior pieces without enough context to classify a clear overall sentiment consistently.
